position_overview: Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that specializes in pairing remote work with top-tier talent. We admire the importance of innovative social media strategies and are committed to connecting talented individuals with great companies that need their unique skills. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located. About the Role We are recruiting for our client, Contara , an agency that helps high-growth CPG brands scale through data-driven Shopify solutions, combining expert development, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and retention marketing strategies that drive measurable revenue growth. They partner with ambitious consumer brands to create better customer experiences, stronger retention systems, and higher-converting digital journeys. As a Copywriter, you'll play a key role in helping these brands grow by creating compelling messaging across email, SMS, landing pages, product pages, and websites. This is a highly conversion-focused role where you'll be expected to adapt your writing style across multiple brands while maintaining a strong focus on customer engagement, retention, and revenue generation. Approximately 75% of the role will focus on retention marketing (Email/SMS) and 25% on conversion-focused website and landing page copy .
